_about: Public-domain John Maclaurin (1693-1754), minister of the Ramshorn Kirk, Glasgow, for the Word Hoard: his Works (Edinburgh: Maclaren, 1860, two volumes, including Glorying in the Cross of Christ) and An Essay on the Prophecies relating to the Messiah (1773), from Internet Archive scans. Not his brother Colin the mathematician. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 46 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
